resources.string: Notifies when CPU, RAM or disk (Ploi Monitoring) crosses the threshold, then when it is back below. Checked on a best-effort basis every 15 minutes at least, while the phone is online; Ploi samples may be delayed. Leave a field empty to ignore a metric.
Consecutive readings above the threshold before alerting:
Enter at least one threshold between 1 and 100%.
Maximum number of watched servers reached (50).
Notifications denied: thresholds are saved but no alert will be shown.
Grace delay before the PIN is asked again when you come back to the app. The “Lock” button stays immediate; restarting the app always locks.
